description: Send a direct message, as the user, to another person. It is delivered to them immediately and cannot be unsent, so show the user the exact text and recipient and get their explicit go-ahead before calling this. Pass thread_id to reply in an existing conversation (replying to a request accepts it), or handle to message someone, starting the conversation if there is none. Plain text, 1–2,000 characters. Starting more than 20 new conversations in 24 hours is refused.

handle.description: Recipient's handle, used when there is no thread_id

name: send_direct_message
